Immigrants and Emigrants (Amendment)
3
Act, No. 31 of 2006
Section  47  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: amended  in  subsection  (1)  of  that  section  by  the  repeal  of
paragraphs (a) and (b)  thereof and the substitution therefor

column2: every offence committed by persons to whom the
provisions of Part III of this Act apply—

(i)
under paragraph (a), paragraph (b), paragraph
(c), paragraph (d), paragraph (e), paragraph (f)
or paragraph (g) of subsection (1) of section
45 ; and

(ii)
under subsection (2) of section 45 in so far as
it  relates  to  paragraph  (a),  paragraph  (b),
paragraph  (c),  paragraph  (d),  paragraph  (e),
paragraph (f) or paragraph (g) of subsection
(1) of that section ;”;
The  following  new  section  is  hereby  inserted

column1: immediately after section 47 of the principal enactment and
shall have effect as section 47A of that enactment :—

column2: 47A. (1) Notwithstanding anything in any other
law, no person accused of an offence under section
45c shall be enlarged on bail except by a High
Court upon proof of exceptional circumstances.
(2) Where there is no express provision made
in respect of the granting of bail for an offence
under  this  Act,  bail  shall  be  granted  by  a
Magistrate.
(3) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary
in  any  other  law,  the  application  of  the
provisions of this section shall extend to every
person who is in remand on the date of coming
into operation of this section.”.
In the event of any  inconsistency between the Sinhala

column1: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
